name: Coordination

subjectOf.text: If Forum Competition between the United States and Europe expands, the acceptable outer bounds of jurisdictional competition may eventually have to be defined by treaty or other multilateral agreement.
subjectOf.abstract: Depending on future developments in this context, however, the acceptable outer bounds of jurisdictional competition by both Europe and the United States might eventually be defined by treaty or other multilateral agreement.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Richard W. Painter, Forum Competition and Choice of Law Competition in Securities Law after Morrison v. National Austral (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2029983
scope_conditions: depends on future expansion of Dutch and other non-U.S. jurisdiction

subjectOf.text: Traditional coordination through hierarchy, command, and control is suboptimal for generating the innovation a firm needs to survive.
subjectOf.abstract: Traditional forms of coordination, with a focus on hierarchy, command, and control, are suboptimal for generating then innovation that allows firms to survive.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176
scope_conditions: firms competing in fast-moving, technology-driven markets

subjectOf.text: Inclusive and unmediated stakeholder relationships demand a much higher degree of cooperation, loyalty, and mutual trust than control-oriented, centralized, and vertical organizational forms do.
subjectOf.abstract: Compared to the more control-oriented, centralized, and vertical organizational forms, inclusive and unmediated relationships among firms' stakeholders require a high degree of cooperation, loyalty, and mutual trust.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, The ‘Unmediated’ and ‘Tech-Driven’ Corporate Governance of Today's Winning Companies (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2922176

subjectOf.text: Smart contracts enabled by blockchain technology allow comprehensive, near error free, and zero transaction and agency cost coordination of agency relationships.
subjectOf.abstract: Smart contracts enabled by blockchain technology allow for the comprehensive, near error free, and zero transaction/agency cost coordination of agency relationships.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Solutions for Agency Problems in Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3373393

subjectOf.text: Social media transfers knowledge from the edges of society into the mainstream by letting holders of marginalized views find kindred spirits, form groups, and incrementally grow influence until their perspective becomes mainstream, shifting the balance of power from a few to the masses.
subjectOf.abstract: Social media allows people who hold otherwise marginalized or underappreciated views to meet kindred spirits online and form groups that promote their shared ideas.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808859

subjectOf.text: The social media coordination function is still largely flawed because the incentive design underlying social proof is suboptimal; decentralized technology solutions can take over that coordination function and improve it.
subjectOf.abstract: Because the incentive design for social proof is suboptimal, the social media coordination function is still largely flawed. Decentralized technology solutions, however, can tap into the coordination function that was inaugurated by social media and improve it.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808859
scope_conditions: applies to social proof metrics such as share counts used as quality proxies

subjectOf.text: High value contribution is self-amplifying in a DAO: when a member adds substantial value, other token holders want to add their skills to the same work product through a policing engagement, which focuses all members' joint efforts on the highest possible value proposition.
subjectOf.abstract: Moreover, if a DAO member adds substantial value to the DAO, other DAO token holders will want to add their skills to the same work product via a policing engagement which focuses all DAO members' joint efforts on the highest possible value proposition.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Fallacies (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783
scope_conditions: members can observe and join high value work products

subjectOf.text: DAOs that rely on third party communication platforms and offer no incentives for engagement suffer impaired coordination and efficiency across the organization.
subjectOf.abstract: Lower scores suggest reliance on third-party platforms and a lack of incentives for engagement, which can impair the organization's overall coordination and efficiency.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Market Meta Analysis 2024 (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5254152
scope_conditions: DAOs without dedicated communication platforms or participation incentives

subjectOf.text: The combined Work and Availability Smart Contract system eliminates the single greatest barrier to private legal codification, namely funding and coordinating high-quality drafting, while aligning incentives toward rapid meritocratic expansion.
subjectOf.abstract: The combined WSC/ASC system thus eliminates the single greatest barrier to private legal codification, funding and coordinating high-quality drafting, while aligning all incentives toward rapid, meritocratic expansion.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The UDLC DAO Operationalizing a Continuously Evolving Universal Digital Law Codex Through Weighted (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5887242

subjectOf.text: Contrary to the Hayekian account in which price is the summary statistic that coordinates dispersed knowledge, the coordinating signal in Computative Economics is not a single scalar price but a composite of price, reputation, and verified generative capacity.
subjectOf.abstract: Hayekian price operates as a summary statistic. The coordinating signal in Computative Economics is not a single scalar price but the composite of price, reputation, and verified generative capacity.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Computative Economics A Framework for Economic Analysis under Computational Abundance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6607458
scope_conditions: applies where outputs are drawn from a generative distribution whose quality price does not convey

subjectOf.text: Coordination in computative settings runs through the interaction of generation functions rather than through a central coordinator, and this decentralization is structural rather than optional, since a central coordinator would itself be a computative agent generating an infinite regress.
subjectOf.abstract: The generative network is decentralized in the sense that coordination occurs through the interaction of generation functions rather than through a central coordinator. This property is structural rather than optional.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Computative Economics A Framework for Economic Analysis under Computational Abundance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6607458
